results.name: 多表Join-注册与发单客户
results.question: 查询2025年全年的注册客户数，注册司机数，发单客户数
results.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册客户数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_driver_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册司机数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer) FROM (SELECT customer_id AS customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_large_handcart_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE order_type = 1 AND toYear(toDateTime(ctime)) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer_id AS customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_valet_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025)) AS "发单客户数"
results.answer:
2025年全年，平台新增注册客户1,032,473人，新增注册司机280,233人，全年有发单行为的客户数为323,980人。也就是说，在全年注册的客户中，约31.4%的人在当年实际发过单（发单客户数÷注册客户数），说明新注册客户转化为实际发单用户的比例约为三成。整体来看，注册客户规模明显大于注册司机规模，而实际发单客户数相对注册客户数仍有一定差距。

注：本次按“注册客户/司机以对应表create_data_time所在年份统计、发单客户为当年在大板/小板/代驾任一业务线发过单的去重客户”口径计算。

metrics.detail: 缺指标=[] 实际=['注册司机数', '发单客户数', '注册客户数']

results.name: 聚合查询-按月
results.question: 按月统计2026年的订单量
results.sql: SELECT formatDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDateTime(ctime)), '%Y-%m') AS `月份`, COUNT(*) AS `订单量` FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE toDateTime(ctime) >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ctime) < '2027-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY `月份` ORDER BY `月份`

understanding.ambiguity: 未明确订单类型（代驾/大板/小板等），按通用订单量处理

results.answer:
2026年订单量整体呈波动上升趋势，1月至8月累计已超过98.6万笔（前8个月合计986,263笔）。其中，1月订单量为107,185笔，2月小幅回落至101,731笔，为目前最低月份；3月明显回升至134,564笔，为前8个月最高峰；此后4月至7月基本稳定在12万至13万笔之间，8月再次升至138,257笔，创出新高。整体来看，下半年订单量高于年初，8月表现最为突出。

注：本次按“订单量=下单总笔数（COUNT(*)）”的通用口径计算，未区分代驾、大板、小板等具体订单类型。

metrics.detail: 缺指标=[] 实际=['代驾订单量', '大板订单量', '订单量']

results.name: 同比-节前对比
results.question: 查询25号前7天同比去年中秋节前7天发单完单率
results.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24' THEN 1 END) AS `本期订单量`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24' AND status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `本期完单量`,
    round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24' AND status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24' THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS `本期完单率`,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05' THEN 1 END) AS `去年同期订单量`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05' AND status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `去年同期完单量`,
    round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05' AND status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05' THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS `去年同期完单率`
FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all
WHERE (toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24')
   OR (toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05')
results.answer:
本期（2026-09-18~2026-09-24）订单量为0，完单量也为0，完单率无法计算（结果为空）。去年同期（2025-09-29~2025-10-05）订单量为34,975单，完单量8,820单，完单率为25.22%，即每100单中约有25单最终完成。由于本期无任何订单数据，无法与去年同期进行有效的同比对比，建议先核实本期数据是否缺失或统计口径是否存在异常。

注：本次按“25号前7天”为2026-09-18~2026-09-24、“去年中秋节前7天”按2025年中秋节（2025-10-06）换算为2025-09-29~2025-10-05、且“发单完单率”拆解为发单率与完单率的口径/假设计算。

results.name: 环比-本月对上月
results.question: 查询本月订单量环比上月
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "本月订单量", SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "上月订单量", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / nullIf(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0), 4) AS "环比增长率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-11-01'

understanding.ambiguity: 环比上月需对比2026-09-01~2026-09-30；'订单量'未限定业务线，可能需按代驾/大板等分别统计

results.answer: 本月订单量为26758笔，上月为134211笔，环比增长率为0.1994，即本月订单量约为上月的19.94%，整体呈明显下降趋势。这里的环比增长率表示本月订单量相对上月的变化幅度，0.1994意味着本月仅达到上月的约两成，订单量大幅减少。注：本次按“订单量=COUNT(*)”口径计算，并假设环比对比区间为2026-09-01至2026-09-30与上月同期，且未区分代驾、大板等业务线。

results.question: 查询2026年9月的GMV、客单价、取消率和接单率
results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "GMV", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN total ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "客单价", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "取消率", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_picked = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "接单率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE ctime >= toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-09-01 00:00:00')) AND ctime < toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-10-01 00:00:00'))
results.answer:

results.name: 复合指标-询价后发单率
results.question: 查询2026年9月的询价后发单率
results.sql: WITH new_users AS (SELECT id AS customer, toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date, toStartOfMonth(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_month FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01'), first_pricing AS (SELECT p.customer, min(p.pricing_time) AS first_pricing_time FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_order_pricing_record_all AS p INNER JOIN new_users AS u ON u.customer = p.customer WHERE toStartOfMonth(p.pricing_time) = u.reg_month GROUP BY p.customer), order_after AS (SELECT o.customer, max(toDateTime(o.ctime) >= fp.first_pricing_time) AS ordered_after FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o INNER JOIN first_pricing AS fp ON fp.customer = o.customer GROUP BY o.customer) SELECT u.reg_date AS `统计日期`, COUNT(*) AS `新注册用户数`, COALESCE(SUM(oa.ordered_after), 0) AS `询价后发单人数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(oa.ordered_after) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `询价后发单率` FROM new_users AS u LEFT JOIN order_after AS oa ON oa.customer = u.customer GROUP BY u.reg_date ORDER BY u.reg_date
results.answer:
2026年9月新注册用户的“询价后发单率”整体在15%—19%之间波动，即每100个当月新注册客户中，约有15—19人在注册当月首次询价之后成功发单。从已展示的前8天数据看，9月1日最低（15.07%），随后逐步走高，到9月5日达到阶段高点19.26%，9月6日回落至15.91%，之后几天稳定在16%—17%左右。整体来看，9月上旬该转化率呈先升后稳的态势，日均新注册用户在1400—1700人之间。

注：本次按“注册当月首次询价之后产生订单的客户数 ÷ 当月注册客户总数”的口径计算，且仅展示了9月前8天数据，完整月度趋势需结合全部30天结果判断。

results.name: 复合指标-发单率
results.question: 查询2026年9月的发单率
results.sql: WITH new_users AS (SELECT id AS customer, toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date, toDateTime(ctime) AS reg_time FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01'), order_stat AS (SELECT o.customer, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 1) AS has_1d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 3) AS has_3d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 7) AS has_7d FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o INNER JOIN new_users AS u ON u.customer = o.customer WHERE toDateTime(o.ctime) >= u.reg_time GROUP BY o.customer) SELECT u.reg_date AS `统计日期`, COUNT(*) AS `新注册用户数`, SUM(os.has_1d) AS `1天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_1d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `1天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_3d) AS `3天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_3d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `3天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_7d) AS `7天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_7d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `7天内发单率` FROM new_users AS u LEFT JOIN order_stat AS os ON os.customer = u.customer GROUP BY u.reg_date ORDER BY u.reg_date
results.answer: 2026年9月新注册用户的发单率整体处于较低水平，且随观察窗口拉长仅小幅上升。从已展示的前8天数据看，1天内发单率大致在13.7%～16.5%之间，3天内发单率在14.2%～17.6%之间，7天内发单率在14.6%～18.3%之间，说明绝大多数注册用户注册后一周内并未发单。分日看，9月4日、5日表现相对最好，7天内发单率分别约17.7%和18.3%；9月1日最低，7天内发单率约14.6%。整体趋势上，9月上旬发单率没有明显持续走高或走低的态势，而是在15%上下波动。这里的“发单率”指某日注册的客户中，在注册后1天、3天、7天内至少产生过一单的人数占当日注册总人数的比例，例如9月1日注册1612人，其中7天内发单235人，发单率约14.58%。注：本次按“注册后N日内产生至少一单的注册客户数÷注册客户总数、且排除注册前订单”的口径计算，结果仅展示了前8天数据。
